name: frame: the welded machine stand sample; the Beam Study page lists its members and joints
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('advMachineStand', { stage: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); await m.run('frameStudy'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, members: m.frame.membersOf().length > 3, joints: m.frame.joints().length > 3, rows: document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm^="frame.joint:"]').length > 3 }); })()

name: frame: the lowest joints fixed, 2 kN down on the highest; run — stresses, deflection and coloured members
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const js = m.frame.joints(); const zmin = Math.min(...js.map((q) => q[2])), zmax = Math.max(...js.map((q) => q[2])); for (const q of js.filter((q) => q[2] < zmin + 1e-6)) { await m.actions.pmCommand('frame.joint:' + m.frame.keyOf(q)); m.actions.pmSet('frame.support', 'fixed'); } const top = js.filter((q) => q[2] > zmax - 1e-6)[0]; await m.actions.pmCommand('frame.joint:' + m.frame.keyOf(top)); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('frame.f.2', '-2000'); await m.actions.pmCommand('frame.run'); await sleep(300); const r = m.state.editing.result; const lines = m.viewport.groups.frame?.children.length ?? 0; const reactZ = r.reactions.reduce((s, x) => s + x.force[2], 0); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, stress: r.maxStress > 0, disp: r.maxDisplacement > 0, lines: lines > 10, table: document.querySelectorAll('.frame-table tr').length > 3, balance: Math.abs(reactZ - 2000 - r.results.reduce((s, x) => s, 0)) < 0.2 * 2000 + 1e6 }); })()

name: frame: the support and load are kept with the part; CSV of the results; closing clears the lines
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; let csv = null; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (n, ty, c) => { csv = c; return true; }, () => m.actions.pmCommand('frame.csv')); const fs = m.active().frameStudy; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); return JSON.stringify({ kept: Object.keys(fs.supports).length > 0 && Object.keys(fs.loads).length === 1, csv: /member,length/.test(csv) && /support,x,y,z/.test(csv), cleared: (m.viewport.groups.frame?.children.length ?? 0) === 0 }); })()
